facts.title: Ubers interaction
facts.text: Three different Ubers styles from Aiku, Don Lorenzo, Niko and NEL Barou on the opponent's side trigger a cutscene and 30-second buff. Three players give 5%; four give 10% shot-only boost. The source lists Aiku/Niko speed, Lorenzo lower cooldown and Barou shot.

facts.title: Rebellion chemistry
facts.text: Snuffy passes to Barou using C. Barou must be next to the goalkeeper box with two opponents nearby and use Stealth-Kill Shot (C); an auto-goal cutscene was announced.

facts.title: NEL Barou polish
facts.text: Lion Shot aimable. Chop Feint faster; if tackled during it cooldown resets to 2s, maximum two times.

history.title: Don Lorenzo revamp
history.text: New kit and goalkeeper-box awakening variant. A Ubers interaction rewards three or four distinct listed styles in the opponent half; new and revised jerseys were announced.

history.title: Snuffy release
history.text: Master Snuffy arrived with defensive and tactical abilities, special animations and Rebellion chemistry with Barou.

history.title: September quality of life
history.text: Watchtower added to Niko. Barou received aim and dribble adjustments; Loki and Lavinho were balanced. One goal counted as 1 MVP point and one save as 0.75. Per-style awakening outfits and party improvements arrived; summer map removed.

history.title: NEL King release
history.text: NEL Barou arrived with Lion Shot, Stealth Kill Shot, Chop Feint, Tyrant Twisted Path, Predator Eye and awakening moves.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Awakening and performance fixes
history.text: Awakening bars draining during cutscenes fixed across many styles; major crash and lag fixes announced for new servers.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Mini update and private server settings
history.text: Old moves and sound effects returned; infinite stamina and infinite flow settings were added to PS+, alongside an option to hide other players' cosmetics.

history.title: Flow balance and fixes
history.text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.

history.title: Mobile controls and fixes
history.text: Movable mobile buttons and new loading screen; shot and steal-cutscene bug fixes. King moved to Legendary; Yukimiya temporarily moved to Legendary before the May 23 reversal.

history.title: NEL Nagi and Singularity
history.text: NEL Nagi World Class at release, with volley and ball-control passives. Singularity flow introduced and other styles adjusted.

history.title: King and flow rework
history.text: King and its associated flow reworked.

history.title: Goal Rush Duos and King
history.text: Goal Rush Duos and King update announced.

history.title: February bug fixes
history.text: Fixed visual awakening freezes, ball respawn and King impact registration issues.
